IS 15024 : 2011/ISO 11442 : 2006 : Technical product documentation - Document managementICS 01.110:35.240.10PGD 24Reaffirmed 2022NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian Standard (First Revision) which is identical with ISO 11442 : 2006 'Technical product documentation - Document management' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Drawings Sectional Committee and approval of the Production and General Engineering Division Council.This standard was originally published in 2001 in four parts which were identical with ISO 11442 -1 to 4 : 1993. This first revision has been harmonized with ISO 11442 : 2006 by adoption to make pace with the latest developments taken place at international level. The Committee has decided that in addition to the above standards, IS 15025 : 2001 'Technical product documentation - Requirements for computer-aided design and draughting - Vocabulary' shall be treated as withdrawn after publication of this standard.
